name: Northam Platinum Holdings Limited
source: Audited consolidated annual financial statements FY2026, statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, year ended 30 June 2026 (PricewaterhouseCoopers unmodified opinion), R000 scaled to ZAR. Cost of sales 39,845,615 is the statement's own cost of sales and carries operating costs 29,042,457, concentrates purchased 6,933,343, refining and other costs 547,287, depreciation and write-offs 1,703,206 and the change in metal inventory 1,619,322. The statement prints no separate operating expenses line, so that row is left empty rather than filled. Operating profit 14,153,013 is the figure the company itself labels operating profit in the SENS results overview (operating margin 26.2 per cent). Bridge from operating profit to profit before tax, all printed: impairment reversal at Eland 2,526,922 plus investment income 1,091,801 plus net foreign exchange gain 5,336 plus sundry income 1,034,442 less finance charges 1,343,944 less sundry expenditure 222,018 equals 17,245,552. Net finance costs row carries the printed finance charges; investment income is disclosed in this note because the panel has one finance row. Basic earnings per share 3,526.1 cents on 393,737,190 weighted shares.
